newsitem.title: USA: U.S. hog and cattle slaughter estimates - trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. hog and cattle slaughter estimates - trade.

text.p: Analysts estimate Friday's hog slaughter from 355,000 to 364,000 head versus 317,000 a week ago and 350,000 a year ago.
Saturday's hog slaughter estimates ranged from 45,000 to 85,000 head against 53,000 a week ago and 275,000 a year ago.
Cattle slaughter estimates ranged from 131,000 to 133,000 head versus 131,000 a week ago and 134,000 a year ago.
Saturday's cattle slaughter estimates ranged from 30,000 to 45,000 head against 35,000 a week ago and 71,000 a year ago.
